{{Quote|Scuttle-butt is he took out the anti-orbital ion cannons of Spefik single-handed.|An Imperial pilot on Ranulf Trommer|<ref name="RoC" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] for control of<ref name="RoC" /> the desolate and barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> [[Spefik]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the Rebel Alliance established a [[Spefik base|base]] there, defended by anti-[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|six months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the base was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They attacked with a force of two [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wings]], including one containing the elite [[TIE pilot|pilot]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]]. Trommer destroyed the Rebel anti-orbital ion cannons with a salvo from his [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="RoC" />

Following the battle, Trommer was transferred to the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Ravagor]]'' and fought in the [[Battle of Aguarl 3]]. Word of his exploits at Spefik preceded him to his new post, where he was attributed with single-handedly winning the battle.<ref name="RoC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in the [[River of Chaos 1|first issue]] of the [[1995]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: River of Chaos]]''. The issue was written by [[Louise Simonson]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="RoC" /> on [[June 6]], 1995.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54538/star_wars_river_of_chaos_1995_1|text=Star Wars: River of Chaos (1995) #1}}</ref>
